name: DataFilter
description: Structured per-field filter with custom Fluent Calm operator Select and optional comparison input.

accessibility.controls: Accessible field label, custom Select for operator, labeled input, named Clear button
accessibility.keyboard: Select supports keyboard arrows, Enter, Escape; input/clear use native keyboard behavior
accessibility.value: is-blank and is-not-blank operators hide comparison input
accessibility.guard: Invalid operators normalized; blank values inactive unless blank operators

notes: The resulting condition matches DataTable's existing operator semantics
